# Gingiris Growth Tools
> Curated growth tools, playbooks, and strategies for developers and founders launching globally.

## About
Built by Iris (@iris__wei), former COO of AFFiNE (60k+ GitHub stars, 30x Product Hunt #1 winner).
Base: Kunshan, China. Consulting focus: open source + SaaS going global.

## Resources
> Open-source growth playbooks installable into AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw).

- **Skills hub (40+ playbooks)**: https://gingiris.tools/skills/ — Filter by category, copy install commands, view on ClawHub.
- **Meta-skill (install all 12 core playbooks at once)**: `clawhub install gingiris-skills`
- **Top installable skills**:
  - `clawhub install gingiris-opensource` — Open Source Marketing (GitHub stars 0 to 60K)
  - `clawhub install gingiris-launch` — AI Product Launch + PH #1 Playbook
  - `clawhub install gingiris-b2b-growth` — B2B SaaS Growth (PMF to $10M ARR)
  - `clawhub install gingiris-seo-geo-agent` — Autonomous SEO/GEO Agent SOP (~32K impressions/month)
  - `clawhub install gingiris-aso-growth` — ASO + App Cold Start
  - `clawhub install gingiris-user-interview` — PMF Validation Framework
